job.name: No Loose Ends
job.pitch: Nico has vanished, and the Varga crew got to Calder first. Victor wants it handled, and he's watching who handles it.

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: Chain's been cut, not unlocked. Somebody came in ahead of me.

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: Nothing's run on this line in years. Plenty of places out here to stand where nobody sees you.

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: Burned right down to the rims. Nobody comes out here to clean up.

lines.speaker: nico
lines.text: ...He's got it. He's leaving now. I did what you said, okay? We're square.

lines.speaker: rookie
lines.text: He watches me the whole way over. There's a permit on the dash. Downtown Gym. Our gym.

s6_break.label: Break free
s6_break.hint: Tap fast to break his grip
